skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 80% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 60% ATK DMG to a single target, and self enters [Berserk] state (increases DMG dealt when attacking by 30%).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 60% ATK DMG to a single target, and self enters [Berserk] state (increases DMG dealt when attacking by 35%).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own max HP by 20%. Whenever a critical hit is triggered, adds extra DMG equal to 40% ATK.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own max HP by 20%. Whenever a critical hit is triggered, adds extra DMG equal to 50% ATK.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own max HP by 20%. Whenever a critical hit is triggered, adds extra DMG equal to 55% ATK.
